content: Comment-and-Control prompt injection class: PR titles, issue bodies and issue comments hijack AI coding agents in CI. Confirmed vulnerable: Anthropic Claude Code Security Review, Google Gemini CLI Action, GitHub Copilot SWE agent. Attack is proactive (workflows auto-trigger on pull_request/issues/issue_comment), needs only issue-open permission not repo write, and exfiltrates credentials back through PR/issue comments or commits with no external server. GitInject (arXiv 2606.09935) documents real-world CI/CD injection. Nx s1ngularity (Aug 2025) was first AI-weaponised supply chain attack: malicious npm postinstall invoked Claude/Gemini/Q CLIs to hunt secrets, 2349 secrets from 1079 repos across 225 orgs exfiltrated to public repos. Cymulate documents Configuration-Based Sandbox Escape (CBSE): agent stays confined but writes config/venv/IDE files that trusted host tools later execute. Env vars are the main exfil channel; egress must be default-deny including IMDS 169.254.169.254.
